summary.title: Rezolv Energy secures financing for 1.3 GWp solar project in Romania
summary.main_point: Rezolv Energy has secured up to €561 million in financing for the 1.3 GWp Dama Solar project in Romania.
bullets: The financing package is valued at €561 million (PV Tech) or up to €561 million ($637.3 million) (pv magazine).
The project is expected to generate approximately 1.8 TWh of electricity annually.
The facility will be located in Arad county and is intended to cover the consumption of over 280,000 households.

summary.title: Over Easy Solar releases 256 W vertical rooftop PV unit
summary.main_point: Over Easy Solar has launched the xM-3 Quattor-256S, a 256 W bifacial vertical PV unit for flat rooftops.
bullets: The company received an Environmental Product Declaration for its xM-3 flat-roof system, covering both panels and mounting structure.
The system's A1-A3 footprint is 51.5 kg CO₂e/m².
The global warming footprint for energy generation is 19 g CO₂e/kWh, based on a yield of 1,000 kWh/kW.

summary.title: Belgium reports results of 2024 PV cable inspection campaign
summary.main_point: Belgium's Federal Public Service Economy tested PV cables from 10 manufacturers to verify performance compliance.
bullets: The campaign aimed to verify compliance with Regulation (EU) No. 305/2011 and prevent unfair competition.
Testing was conducted by the Scientific Institute of Public Service using laboratory analysis of collected samples.
The assessment included cables with a cross-section of 4 mm².

summary.title: Global solar capacity additions reached 690 GW in 2025
summary.main_point: Global solar installations grew by 15% in 2025 to reach 690 GW, according to IEA-PVPS.
bullets: Cumulative global solar capacity reached 2.96 TW by the end of 2025.
China led global installations with 415 GW, followed by India (54 GW), the United States (43 GW), Germany (18 GW), and Pakistan (14 GW).
India's industrial sector accounted for the second-highest share of its 3.8 GW rooftop solar additions in the second quarter of 2026 (Mercom India).

summary.title: Fox ESS launches modular C&I battery storage system
summary.main_point: Fox ESS has introduced the Power Beast modular storage system, which can scale up to 96 MWh.
bullets: The system is scalable from 28 kWh to nearly 1,000 kWh on a single inverter.
Maximum on-grid configuration allows for 96 MWh, while off-grid is limited to 28.8 MWh.
The system utilizes 125 kW H3 Plus hybrid inverters and CQ series high-voltage batteries.

summary.title: TrueRE Oriana Power sells 110 MWp solar portfolio to Actis
summary.main_point: TrueRE Oriana Power has sold a 110 MWp C&I solar portfolio to Actis for an enterprise value of INR 501 crore.
bullets: The sale is part of a larger proposed divestment of 238 MW of operational solar assets.
The company transferred its stake in Truere Guj SPV Pvt Ltd and Truere Current Pvt Ltd.

summary.title: Heliene launches new rooftop solar module
summary.main_point: Heliene has introduced an all-black solar module for the US rooftop market and secured a supply agreement with Sunrun.
bullets: The new module is designed specifically for the rooftop solar sector.
The company has entered into a supply agreement with Sunrun.

summary.title: Exus acquires 715 MWp solar portfolio in the US
summary.main_point: Exus Renewables North America has purchased a four-project solar portfolio totaling 715 MWp from ibV Energy Partners.
bullets: The acquisition consists of four separate solar projects.

summary.title: 150 MW Three W Solar project completed in Texas
summary.main_point: Black & Veatch has completed the 150 MW Three W Solar project in Hillsboro, Texas, for Mitsui & Co.
bullets: The project has achieved substantial completion.
The facility has received approval from ERCOT.

summary.title: X-Elio starts commercial operations at 368MW Spanish solar PV project
summary.main_point: X-Elio has commenced commercial operations at its 368MW Lorca Solar project in Spain.
bullets: The Lorca Solar project is X-Elio's largest solar PV project in Spain.

summary.title: Spanish researchers validate 10,000 cycles for iron-lead flow battery
summary.main_point: CIC energiGUNE has successfully tested an iron-lead redox flow battery for 10,000 charge-discharge cycles.
bullets: The battery design uses abundant materials and a fluorine-free membrane to reduce internal resistance.
The technology is intended for stationary applications requiring several hours of storage.

summary.title: Ireland energizes first SRESS solar farm
summary.main_point: The 650 kW Meadhill Solar farm in County Cork is the first project energized under Ireland's Small-Scale Renewable Energy Support Scheme.
bullets: The project generates enough energy to power approximately 150 homes.
The developer has signed a 15-year power purchase agreement with Flogas.

summary.title: South Korea grid overhaul to connect more than 100 GW of renewables
summary.main_point: South Korea's Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment is lifting renewable energy connection restrictions in the Honam and Chungcheong regions.
bullets: Restrictions on the east coast are scheduled to be lifted in the first half of 2027.
A new flexible connection regime will allow projects to connect beyond normal hosting limits, subject to curtailment.

summary.title: Assam DISCOM invites bids to install solar projects and solar trees
summary.main_point: The Assam Power Distribution Company has issued a tender for 950 kW of solar projects and five 10 kW solar trees.
bullets: The installation is planned for Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev Avirbhav Kshetra in the Nagaon district.

summary.title: ACME Solar commissions additional 107.36 MW/437.49 MWh of BESS capacity
summary.main_point: ACME Solar has added 107.36 MW/437.49 MWh of battery energy storage capacity in Rajasthan, bringing its total operational capacity to 4.96 GWh.
bullets: The new capacity includes a 53.73 MW/222.969 MWh project and a 53.63 MW/214.52 MWh project.
The firm and dispatchable renewable energy project has a 25-year power purchase agreement.

summary.title: Heliene launches new solar rooftop module
summary.main_point: Heliene has introduced an all-black solar module for the US rooftop market and secured a supply agreement with Sunrun.
bullets: The module is designed specifically for residential rooftop applications.

summary.title: Overview Energy to develop homing beacon for space-based solar transmission
summary.main_point: Overview Energy has received a Department of War contract to develop a homing beacon for space-based solar energy systems.
bullets: The beacons are designed to authenticate connections between satellites and ground receiving sites to prevent signal spoofing.

summary.title: California governor signs bills approving virtual power plants
summary.main_point: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 913 and SB 905, authorizing the implementation of virtual power plants across California.
bullets: The legislation aims to reduce electricity bills by utilizing home and business energy equipment.

summary.title: German startup wins grant for grid-charging sodium-ion home battery
summary.main_point: Revolta AG has received funding from the German state of Hesse to develop a sodium-ion AC battery for residential use.
bullets: The project has eligible costs of €660,545 with a 40% EU co-financing rate.
The system is designed to charge when grid prices are low and discharge when prices are high.
The project is scheduled to run from Aug. 1, 2026, to Dec. 31, 2029.

summary.title: Spain’s first pre-commercial marine solar demonstrator enters testing
summary.main_point: A 1 MW floating solar installation developed by BlueNewables and Naturgy has begun testing at the Port of Valencia.
bullets: The installation consists of two 500 kW PV-bos platforms.
Testing will evaluate performance, maintenance requirements, and integration into port infrastructure.

summary.title: Germany sitting on 600,000 tonnes of solar PV waste by 2030
summary.main_point: Germany is projected to generate over 600,000 tonnes of solar PV waste by 2030.
bullets: The waste material is estimated to be potentially worth billions in aluminium and silver.

summary.title: Developments in Indian battery energy storage capacity
summary.main_point: The Solar Energy Corporation of India has invited bids for standalone battery storage projects, while Adani Green Energy has expanded its operational capacity.
bullets: Adani Green Energy Ltd has increased its operational BESS capacity to 6.63 GWh at Khavda, Gujarat (pv magazine India).
Adani Green Energy Ltd claims to account for over 50% of India's total operational BESS capacity of about 12.6 GWh (pv magazine India).
The Solar Energy Corporation of India has floated a tender for standalone battery energy storage systems for on-demand use (Mercom India).

summary.title: Japan tightens grid access as battery queue reaches 172 GW
summary.main_point: Japan's grid operator has introduced new measures to prevent capacity hoarding in a battery storage queue that has reached 172 GW.
bullets: Projects receiving grid connection approval from Oct. 1 must prove site usage rights within two months to maintain their reservation.
Less than 1 GW of grid-scale storage is currently connected in Japan.

summary.title: Milky Mist Banks on 25 MW Solar Project for Energy Self-Sufficiency
summary.main_point: Contributing nearly a quarter of the world’s milk supply, India’s dairy industry employs more than 80 million farmers.

summary.title: California governor signs balcony solar and VPP legislation
summary.main_point: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed legislation legalizing balcony solar systems in the state.
bullets: SB 868, the Plug and Play Solar Act, was signed to eliminate red tape for balcony solar systems.
California is the 10th state to legalize balcony solar.

summary.title: India approves US$19.3 billion Green Energy Corridor Phase III with 50GWh BESS
summary.main_point: India's Union Cabinet has approved US$ 19.3 billion Green Energy Corridor, including US$ 5.2 billion for 50GWh BESS through FY2032-33.

summary.title: McKinsey report finds trade barriers increase U.S. storage costs
summary.main_point: A McKinsey & Company report projects that trade fragmentation could increase capital expenditure for battery energy storage by 40% to 50%.
bullets: Cost increases are attributed to cathode material tariffs, critical mineral bottlenecks, and supply chain localization barriers.

summary.title: SIAD Group commissions PV-powered hydrogen plant in Italy
summary.main_point: SIAD Group has inaugurated a 2 MW PEM electrolyzer in Pignataro Maggiore, Italy, powered by a 2.37 MW photovoltaic field and a 1 MW battery storage system.
bullets: The project represents an investment of more than €12 million, including €8 million in funding from Italy’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan.
Renewable hydrogen produced at the facility will be compressed to pressures of up to 500 bar for industrial customers.

summary.title: Denmark adopts new grid connection prioritization model
summary.main_point: The Danish parliament has approved an emergency plan that replaces the first-come, first-served grid connection principle with a new prioritization model.
bullets: The model establishes four priority categories, with critical societal functions and new households in the highest category.
Renewable energy, carbon capture, storage, and hydrogen projects are placed in the second category, while energy storage is in the third.

summary.title: Alight acquires 2GW Swedish solar and storage pipeline
summary.main_point: Alight has purchased a portfolio of 40 utility-scale solar projects from Soltech Energy Solutions in southern Sweden.
bullets: The acquired pipeline has a total capacity of 2GW.

summary.title: Research explores railway-integrated solar potential in South Korea
summary.main_point: An international research team identified that five surface railway corridors in South Korea could host over 8.5 MW of PV capacity.
bullets: The study suggests using railway corridors to expand solar generation without competing for scarce land in densely populated areas.

summary.title: Global polysilicon prices remain stable
summary.main_point: The Global Polysilicon Marker remained unchanged at $19.312/kg, or $0.041/W, according to the OPIS Global Solar Markets Report.
bullets: Market participants face potential difficulties in fulfilling long-term delivery obligations after November.

summary.title: Battery storage adoption in U.S. residential solar grows
summary.main_point: Battery storage was paired with 37% of new U.S. residential solar systems in 2025, an increase from 25% in 2024.
bullets: In California, 74% of new residential solar installations included storage in 2025, up from 58% in 2024.
The 2025 data covers approximately 450,000 systems, representing an estimated 93% of the U.S. distributed solar market for the year.

summary.title: Clean Capital discusses middle market community solar operations
summary.main_point: Clean Capital operates as an independent power producer in the middle market, managing community solar, commercial, and industrial assets across 26 states.
bullets: The company is backed by Manulife Investment Company and has been in operation for approximately 10 years.

summary.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain completes 12.37-MW solar carport project
summary.main_point: Six Flags Magic Mountain has energized a 12.37-MW solar carport project developed with Solar Optimum.
bullets: The installation is described as the largest solar carport project in California and one of the largest single-site commercial solar carport projects in the United States.

summary.title: Next2Sun files for insolvency for two subsidiaries
summary.main_point: German vertical PV specialist Next2Sun has filed for self-administered insolvency proceedings for two companies within its corporate group at the Saarbrücken Local Court, in Germany, following an unsuccessful fundraising campaign .

summary.title: Statkraft and Greenvolt sign largest EU battery energy storage tolling agreement for projects in Poland
summary.main_point: Statkraft and Greenvolt Power have signed a 10-year tolling agreement covering 400MW of BESS across two operating projects in Poland.

summary.title: EU grants cross-border solar, wind project priority status
summary.main_point: A hybrid solar-wind project connecting Poland and Germany is among three projects that have been granted cross-border renewable energy status (CB RES) by the European Commission.

summary.title: Waaree Energies commissions 1.1GW PV inverter nameplate capacity
summary.main_point: Waaree Power Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Indian PV cell and module manufacturer Waaree Energies, has started commercial operations at a 1.1GW solar inverter manufacturing line.

summary.title: Success of Green Energy Corridor III Hinges on Timely Project Execution
summary.main_point: The Green Energy Corridor Phase III (GEC III) program has the potential to create new opportunities for transmission equipment suppliers, EPC firms, battery storage providers, and grid technology companies as India develops infrastructure to accommodate an extra 135 GW of renewable energy.

summary.title: MERC Allows Time Extension for Solar Projects Facing Transmission Delays
summary.main_point: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (MERC) has allowed, in principle, a petition seeking revision of the scheduled commencement of supply dates (SCSD) for solar projects where the associated transmission evacuation infrastructure is expected to be commissioned after the contractual tim

summary.title: First Solar Files Patent Infringement Case Against JA Solar, American Panel
summary.main_point: US-based solar technology and manufacturing company, First Solar, has filed a lawsuit against JA Solar and American Panel Solutions (AMPS), alleging unauthorized use of a patent related to tunnel oxide passivated contact (TOPCon) technology .The U.S.

summary.title: Distributed solar interconnection timelines stretch to nearly four years for larger projects
summary.main_point: Larger distributed solar projects can spend years working through the interconnection process.

summary.title: The U.S. market is writing its own sodium-ion spec
summary.main_point: Sodium-ion battery cells are manufactured on largely the same equipment and process steps as lithium cells, which has helped scale production faster than alternative chemistries like flow batteries or nickel-hydrogen.

summary.title: German startup offers AI platform to accelerate battery storage engineering
summary.main_point: Morreon GmbH is developing an AI-based operating system called Anchor to streamline the planning and execution of energy infrastructure projects.
bullets: The platform integrates document processing, engineering design, cost management, tendering, and project scheduling.
It targets battery energy storage systems, substations, electric truck charging infrastructure, and data centers.
The first stage of the platform converts unstructured inputs like PDFs, CAD files, and emails into standardized engineering briefs.

summary.title: Poland unveils new home storage subsidy
summary.main_point: Poland’s Ministry of Climate and Environment has announced a $257.9 million (PLN 1 billion) subsidy scheme for home battery and heat storage, aimed at increasing self-consumption from residential solar and other renewable energy installations.

summary.title: Polish rural energy program supports renewables and storage
summary.main_point: A Polish program provided financing for agricultural renewable energy installations and integrated energy storage systems.
bullets: Eligible projects included solar and wind installations between 50 kW and 1 MW, and hydro or biogas plants between 10 kW and 1 MW.
Energy cooperatives were permitted to install systems between 10 kW and 10 MW.
Support included loans for solar and wind, and grants of 45 to 65 percent for biogas and hydro, while energy storage received up to 20 percent funding.

summary.title: MAHAPREIT Floats O&M Tender for Solar Project in Maharashtra
summary.main_point: Mahatma Phule Renewable Energy and Infrastructure Technology (MAHAPREIT) has invited bids to provide operation and maintenance (O&M) services for a grid-connected solar power project at Kelapur in Maharashtra’s Wardha district.The project entails providing five years of O&M services for a 3 MW solar

summary.title: Japan proposes four categories for priority commercial solar support
summary.main_point: Japan's Agency for Natural Resources and Energy proposed maintaining feed-in support for specific commercial solar categories while phasing out others.
bullets: Support will continue for solar on government land, municipal decarbonization projects, carports, and infrastructure like airports and railways.
New ground-mounted commercial solar will lose FIT and FIP support starting April 1, 2027.

summary.title: Solex secures INR 194.14 crore orders for TOPCon solar modules
summary.main_point: Gujarat-based Solex Energy and its subsidiary secured orders totaling INR 194.14 crore for TOPCon bifacial solar modules.
bullets: Solex Green Energy received an order worth INR 180.98 crore, while Solex Energy received an order for INR 13.16 crore.
The company operates a 4 GW annual production facility in Tadkeshwar, Gujarat.

summary.title: Developments in U.S. solar legislation and patent litigation
summary.main_point: U.S. solar news includes the classification of balcony solar as appliances and a new patent lawsuit regarding TOPCon technology.
bullets: Thirty-five states and D.C. have enacted or are deliberating legislation regarding plug-in balcony solar (Solar Power World).
First Solar filed a patent infringement lawsuit against JA Solar and American Panel Solutions regarding TOPCon cell manufacturing methods (pv magazine India).

summary.title: Linea Energy closes financing for 500 MWh Texas battery project
summary.main_point: Linea Energy secured debt financing and preferred equity for its 250 MW/500 MWh Mesa View battery storage project in Texas.
bullets: The project is located in Upton County and is scheduled to reach commercial operation in 2027.
NORD/LB acted as coordinating lead arranger, with D.E. Shaw Renewable Investments providing the preferred equity commitment.

summary.title: Research evaluates economic impact of rural U.S. solar and wind
summary.main_point: A University of Missouri working paper analyzes the local economic effects of utility-scale wind and solar in rural U.S. counties from 2000 to 2022.
bullets: The study compares rural counties hosting utility-scale installations against non-adopting peer counties.
Researchers examined the impact on gross domestic product, wage-and-salary employment, and total earnings.

summary.title: Auroracell launches 9.7 kwh sodium-ion chromium oxide residential battery
summary.main_point: Bulgaria-based Auroracell has introduced a 9.7 kWh residential energy storage system utilizing sodium-ion chromium oxide battery technology.
bullets: The technology uses a specific cathode chemistry designed to improve battery life, thermal stability, and performance across a wider temperature range.
The system is designed to address typical sodium-ion limitations such as lower energy density and performance constraints at temperature extremes.

summary.title: Thousands of european solar park systems exposed online, say researchers
summary.main_point: Researchers identified 8,547 internet-facing systems at European solar and wind projects that should not be reachable from the internet.
bullets: Solar projects accounted for 7,942 of the exposed systems across 34 countries.
Spain had 2,766 exposed systems, followed by Greece with 1,860, Italy with 753, and Germany with 672.

summary.title: Bw ess starts building 828mwh bess in italy
summary.main_point: BESS owner-operator BW ESS has begun construction on its second large-scale project in Italy within one month.
bullets: The project is an 828 MWh battery energy storage system.
Developers Galileo and Aura Power have also progressed their respective portfolios in Italy.

summary.title: Tata power renewables and seci report rooftop solar updates
summary.main_point: The Solar Energy Corporation of India has invited bids for rooftop solar projects in New Delhi, while Tata Power Renewables reported reaching over 5.67 GWp of cumulative rooftop capacity.
bullets: Tata Power Solaroof completed 88,397 installations in the July-September quarter (Q2 FY27), representing 426 MWp of capacity.
During the first six months of FY27, Tata Power Solaroof added over 168,530 installations totaling 801 MWp of capacity.
Tata Power Solaroof has surpassed 5.67 GWp of cumulative rooftop solar capacity across 575,000 installations.

summary.title: Bondada engineering secures solar epc order and financing for subsidiary
summary.main_point: Bondada Engineering Ltd received an EPC order worth INR 1,153.93 crore for a 270 MWp solar project in Maharashtra, while its subsidiary Onix IPP secured financing for a 225 MW project.
bullets: The EPC order for the 270 MWp project is to be executed over a six-month period.

summary.title: Heterojunction solar cell achieves 25.96% efficiency with biomass-based paste
summary.main_point: Researchers at Guangdong University of Technology developed a silver paste using biomass lignin that enabled silicon heterojunction solar cells to reach 25.96% efficiency.
bullets: The lignin-based paste replaces 25% of petroleum-based bisphenol F epoxy resin.
The strategy uses solvent fractionation followed by epoxidation grafting to convert lignin into a functional binder.

summary.title: Zelestra secures $350 million for indiana solar project
summary.main_point: Zelestra closed a $350 million credit facility for its 203 MW Reclamation solar project in Indiana.
bullets: The project is backed by a long-term power purchase agreement with Meta.
This financing brings Zelestra's total U.S. capital raised in 2026 to $1.14 billion.

summary.title: Hithium and antora energy announce energy storage developments
summary.main_point: Hithium is advancing sodium-ion storage toward large-scale deployment, while Antora Energy announced a 5.8 GWh thermal energy storage project in Kansas.
bullets: Antora Energy's project is located at Pratt Energy’s biorefinery in Pratt, Kansas.
Hithium views sodium-ion technology as a way to address concerns regarding lithium resource concentration and price volatility.

summary.title: Report finds high defect rates in solar assets
summary.main_point: The 2026 SolarGrade PV Health Report by HelioVolta found that 87% of inspected solar projects contained major issues that impact safety and financial yield.
bullets: The report assessed nearly 8 GW of PV assets across more than 1,500 projects in the U.S. and Puerto Rico.
Quality issues can increase a system's levelized cost of energy by more than 20% (Solar Power World).

summary.title: European solar and wind systems identified as vulnerable to cyber risks
summary.main_point: Researchers have identified thousands of internet-facing systems linked to solar and wind energy assets across Europe, highlighting potential cybersecurity threats.
bullets: Modat identified 8,547 internet-facing systems linked to solar parks and wind farms across 35 European countries (Mercom India).
A joint Dutch team of researchers reported that almost 8,000 European solar energy systems are exposed to internet cyberattacks (PV Tech).

summary.title: Sungrow patches iSolarCloud vulnerability following security research
summary.main_point: Sungrow deployed an emergency patch to its iSolarCloud platform after researchers discovered a vulnerability that allowed unauthorized account access.
bullets: The vulnerability was reported to Sungrow on Aug. 22 by an independent researcher working with Jakkaru.
Sungrow deployed an emergency patch across all iSolarCloud levels on Aug. 25, resolving the issue the same day.
The flaw affected the cloud infrastructure, potentially exposing all inverters connected to the platform.

summary.title: Maxxen Energy operates containerized battery manufacturing facility in Türkiye
summary.main_point: Maxxen Energy is operating a 20,000-square-meter containerized battery manufacturing plant in Aydın, Türkiye, which began operations in 2026.
bullets: The facility produces a 5 MWh DC Box container and an optional MV Box power station with outputs of 2.5 MW, 5.0 MW, or 10 MW.
Maxxen is headquartered in Switzerland and is a subsidiary of Kontek Energy.

summary.title: Punjab Energy Development Agency invites bids for solar projects
summary.main_point: The Punjab Energy Development Agency has issued a tender for grid-connected rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects using the RESCO model.
bullets: The projects will feature a net metering or net billing facility.

summary.title: MERC approves compensation for solar developer generation losses
summary.main_point: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission ordered the Maharashtra State Power Generation Company to pay ₹11.10 million in compensation for deemed generation losses.
bullets: The compensation relates to a 50 MW solar project that could not evacuate power due to grid unavailability.

summary.title: SECI Invites Bids to Set Up Wind Projects Across India
summary.main_point: Listen to this article The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has floated a tender to set up interstate transmission system (ISTS)-connected wind projects nationwide.

summary.title: Recent utility-scale solar project developments in the United States
summary.main_point: New utility-scale solar projects have been completed in Minnesota and secured financing in Indiana.
bullets: Cedar Creek Energy completed the 5.046-MW Ramsey II Renewable Station in Minnesota.
Zelestra secured $350 million in financing for its 203 MW Reclamation solar project in Indiana, which is backed by a power purchase agreement with Meta.

summary.title: Green Clean Solar manages solar panel recycling in Georgia
summary.main_point: Green Clean Solar is providing recycling services for damaged solar panels at a project site in Maysville, Georgia.
bullets: The company specializes in managing solar waste generated during construction and operations.

summary.title: AMMP launches AI tool for renewable energy asset management
summary.main_point: Data platform AMMP has introduced an AI coworker named Ray to assist renewable energy asset management teams with reporting and decision-making.
bullets: The tool is designed to integrate into existing asset management workflows to identify problems and draft reports.

summary.title: Dutch researchers calculate green hydrogen costs as low as €7.2/kg
summary.main_point: A study of a 200 MW electrolyzer in the Netherlands found that long-term revenue guarantees are necessary for financial viability, with LCOH ranging from €7.2/kg to €7.7/kg depending on the sourcing configuration.
bullets: The levelized cost of hydrogen was approximately €7.2/kg to €7.3/kg for PPA and hybrid configurations.
Wholesale electricity sourcing resulted in an LCOH of €7.7/kg.
Researchers concluded that all three configurations remain financially unviable without additional support, such as a hydrogen contract for difference.

summary.title: Dos Grados acquires 500MW-plus of solar projects from Akuo in Spain
summary.main_point: Dos Grados has reached an agreement to purchase three solar PV projects from Akuo with a combined capacity exceeding 500MW.
bullets: The acquisition involves three PV solar projects located in Spain.
The total installed capacity of the projects is more than 500MW.

summary.title: BESS industry buzz: optimisation and curtailment in GB
summary.main_point: The latest BESS Industry Buzz highlights ongoing discussions regarding battery energy storage system optimisation, curtailment, and revenue trends across Europe.
bullets: The report covers industry sentiment regarding BESS deal-making and revenue generation.

summary.title: MNRE Adds 402 MW of Solar Cell Capacity to ALMM, Total Nears 38 GW
summary.main_point: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has added 402 MW of solar cell manufacturing capacity to the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II, taking the total enlisted capacity to 37.8 GW.

summary.title: China wafer prices hold steady amid divergent output plans
summary.main_point: China's wafer market prices remained stable ahead of the Golden Week holiday, with producers showing varying production strategies for the fourth quarter.
bullets: FOB China N-type M10 and 210R wafer prices remained unchanged at $0.149/pc and $0.153/pc respectively.
Wafer inventories are estimated at approximately 25 GW.
Some manufacturers are reportedly planning to increase output in October despite a lack of consensus on production cuts.

summary.title: Prices drive Pakistan’s metered solar, outages drive hidden uptake
summary.main_point: A study by researchers from Pakistan and the United Kingdom identifies two distinct solar adoption channels in Pakistan: registered net metering for high-income users and unregistered off-grid systems in areas with poor grid reliability.
bullets: The research combined data from Ember, NEPRA, and Renewables First to analyze solar adoption at the distribution-company level.
Registered net metering is primarily utilized by higher-income customers in well-served utility areas.

summary.title: Batteries beat gas peakers on cost globally
summary.main_point: Wood Mackenzie reports that four-hour battery storage has become cheaper than open-cycle gas turbines across all 43 modeled global markets, though North America faces specific trade and policy challenges.
bullets: Single-axis tracker solar is the lowest-cost new-build power source in 43 of 48 modeled markets.
North American energy storage investment is being supported by data center demand and rising peaking costs.

summary.title: Thermal energy storage delivers industrial heat and grid solutions
summary.main_point: Thermal energy storage systems are being positioned to reduce industrial reliance on natural gas while offering potential solutions for renewable energy curtailment.
bullets: A September 2026 IEA report suggested a 35% global electrification target by 2035 is within reach using existing technologies.
MGA Thermal is developing electro-thermal energy storage systems to manage industrial loads and grid issues.

summary.title: Voltus raises $225 million for demand flexibility portfolio
summary.main_point: Virtual power plant operator Voltus raised $225 million in a Series D funding round to support its goal of building a 20 GW demand flexibility portfolio.
bullets: The funding round was led by Generation Investment Management, with Activate Capital and Vitol as co-leads.
Voltus enrolls distributed energy resource owners to help grid operators meet peak demand.
The North American Electric Reliability Corporation estimates a need for over 270 gigawatts of new peak capacity.

summary.title: Austria receives 43,300 solar subsidy applications in ten minutes
summary.main_point: Austria's final funding round for photovoltaic and battery storage systems saw 43,300 applications submitted within the first 10 minutes of the portal opening.
bullets: The Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs, Energy and Tourism reported that demand exceeded the second funding round, which saw 24,900 tickets in the first 10 minutes.
The government is reconsidering its subsidy approach following the high demand and recent consultations.

summary.title: Sunbooster secures European patent for bifacial photovoltaic fences
summary.main_point: Austrian company Sunbooster has patented a vertical bifacial photovoltaic fence solution now protected in 18 European Union member states.
bullets: The system uses 18.6 cm-high bifacial strips with a conversion efficiency of 22.8%.
Strips are rated at 62 W for a 2-meter length or 79 W for a 2.5-meter length.
The company is targeting expansion in the French market, where it has completed its first installation.

summary.title: Italy faces grid connection requests exceeding 300 GW
summary.main_point: Renewable energy connection requests in Italy have reached over 300 GW, significantly higher than the capacity planned for 2030.
bullets: Since September, grid access is granted based on who obtains authorization first rather than the order of application.

summary.title: NTPC tenders solar and storage projects while POWERGRID commissions transmission line
summary.main_point: POWERGRID has commissioned a transmission project for a 2,500 MW solar zone in Karnataka, while NTPC has issued tenders for a 1 GW solar project and a 3,300 MWh BESS.
bullets: POWERGRID commissioned the Bidar, Karnataka project on October 5, 2026.
NTPC Renewable Energy Ltd is seeking EPC services for a 1 GW ground-mounted solar project in Andhra Pradesh.
NTPC Green Energy Ltd is seeking an EPC package for a 3,300 MWh battery energy storage system at the Khavda solar plant in Gujarat.

summary.title: India adds 402 MW of solar cell capacity to ALMM list
summary.main_point: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has updated its Approved List of Models and Manufacturers, bringing total enlisted solar cell capacity to 37.8 GW.
bullets: The 12th revision of the list was issued on 8 October 2026 (PV Tech).

summary.title: Majority of U.S. solar manufacturing expansion plans lack financing
summary.main_point: Over 70% of announced U.S. solar manufacturing expansion plans have not yet been financed, according to the Solar Manufacturing USA Quarterly report.
bullets: Solar PV manufacturing capital expenditure is forecast to decline year-on-year in 2027 compared to 2026 figures of approximately $3 billion.

summary.title: Clearway begins construction on 650 MW Swan Energy Center
summary.main_point: Clearway Energy Group has closed financing and commenced construction on the 650 MW Swan Energy Center in Bates County, Missouri.
bullets: Construction is expected to continue through the middle of 2028.
The project site will employ up to 500 workers during the construction period.
